snippet.title: Version 1.1 "Timeless Bonds" Now Available | Where Winds Meet
snippet.description:
Kaifeng's nights blaze with stories old and new.
When the past returns, it comes with moonlight on the Bian River, fireworks above Revelry Hall, and nights filled with laughter and chance encounters.

Raise a cup to the moment, no matter where your path leads.
New Region Kaifeng: Roaring Sands is now available.

Pre-Download on Mobile: 
https://bit.ly/49ErYfga
Download the latest version for PC and PlayStation: https://www.wherewindsmeetgame.com/
